title: Server container — pinned, non-root image with a health check, and a standalone Helm values sketch

tasks.title: Dockerfile, production server entry, migrate command and the Dockerfile rules
Helm values sketch for a standalone namespace

acs.text: WHEN `release check-dockerfile` reads the Dockerfile THE SYSTEM SHALL pass only if every `FROM` names an exact version tag and a sha256 digest, no instruction fetches a URL (`ADD <url>`, `curl`, `wget`), the final stage sets a non-root `USER`, and a `HEALTHCHECK` calls `/api/v1/health`; each violation SHALL be reported with its line and the fix
scenarios: AC-001 the Dockerfile passes the image rules
AC-001 a Dockerfile that breaks a rule is refused

acs.text: WHEN the image runs with `DATABASE_URL` pointing at a migrated database THE SYSTEM SHALL answer `GET /api/v1/health` with 200 and an unauthenticated `GET /api/v1/rooms` with 401 on port 3200, report healthy to Docker, run as a non-root user, stop on SIGTERM within 10 seconds, and carry a migrate command that applies the committed migrations
scenarios: AC-002 the image serves the API

acs.text: WHEN the Helm values sketch is read THE SYSTEM SHALL name its own namespace, the image by digest, a non-root security context, liveness and readiness probes on `/api/v1/health`, and every environment variable the server reads, each taken from a ConfigMap or a Secret by name, with no secret value in the file
